finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into a full outage.**

`redis` connection was lost at `02:14:07` (`ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`). Cache fell back to direct store reads, causing constant cache miss storms and 5s timeouts across `api`, `worker-1`, `worker-2`, `scheduler`.

Reconnect attempts kept failing every ~2 min, 12 tries total, last at `02:31:26`. Meanwhile request queue depth climbed from 52 to over 560, way past the max of 500.

At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` from the backlog and restarted. At `02:31:52` the supervisor killed the whole process group: `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down`.

Full log at [logs/app.log](logs/app.log), timeline from `L182` to `L719`.

Next: fix or failover the `redis` instance at `10.0.0.12:6379` and cap queue depth so overload degrades instead of OOMing.
